summary: Maps AuthSpec instances to driver kwargs via AUTH_TO_DRIVER_KWARGS registry. Provides auth_to_driver_kwargs() and convenience auth_kwargs() for profile objects.

key_functions.name: auth_to_driver_kwargs
key_functions.summary: Looks up the registered mapper for an AuthSpec instance and returns driver kwargs. Raises KeyError if no mapper registered.

key_functions.name: auth_kwargs
key_functions.summary: Convenience: extracts .auth from any object and dispatches to auth_to_driver_kwargs. Returns {} if no auth attribute.

key_functions.name: _oauth2
key_functions.summary: Returns {token} or {credential} depending on available fields.

key_functions.name: _iam
key_functions.summary: Returns AWS credential kwargs (role_arn, access_key_id, etc.).

extension_points: Register new auth type mappers by adding entries to AUTH_TO_DRIVER_KWARGS dict
Backend adapters can override individual auth types with bespoke match statements
lifecycle_notes: WindowsAuth, AzureADAuth, KerberosAuth, ServiceAccountAuth, CertificateAuth have no default mapper — their backend adapters handle mapping directly
documentation_hooks: Table showing which auth types have default mappers vs. require backend-specific handling
Example of adding a custom mapper
risks: KeyError if caller passes an auth type without a registered mapper and doesn't handle it
